Typical tasks

What we automate for you

  • Sorting and answering emails

    Incoming requests are recognised, prioritised and given a draft reply.

  • Reading documents

    Invoices, delivery notes and forms are read and their data captured in structured form.

  • Moving data between tools

    Information from email, forms or PDFs lands automatically in your CRM, ERP or spreadsheet.

  • AI chatbot for website and support

    Answers common questions around the clock, based on your own content.

  • Preparing quotes and copy

    Drafts for quotes, product texts or reports from the data you already have.

  • Internal knowledge search

    Staff find answers in manuals, contracts and policies by asking instead of searching.

FAQ

Answers up front

Do I need my own IT team or coding skills?

No. We handle development, setup and operation. You only need access to the systems we connect.

What happens to our data?

In the intro call we clarify which data is processed and where. The solution is built to match your data protection requirements, including a data processing agreement.

Does the AI make decisions on its own?

Only if you want it to. Usually the AI prepares and a person approves, for example for quotes or replies to customers.

How much does an automation cost?

After the intro call you get a fixed price. Smaller automations are often done within a few days.
